scripts.clean: find src -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf dist 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'All cleaned!'
scripts.clean:full: find src -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf dist node_modules bun.lockb 2>/dev/null || true && bun install && echo 'Full clean complete!'
scripts.dev:test: NODE_ENV=test bunx prisma migrate deploy && NODE_ENV=test bun --watch src/index.ts
scripts.test: bun clean && NODE_ENV=test bun test src/tests/*.spec.ts src/tests/**/*.spec.ts
